summary: New briefing: verify the Print Tags page (/print-tags) correctly tiles A4 sheets under real print-media emulation on a mobile (390x844) viewport -- the fix pins the grid to 210mm with explicit per-size grid-template-columns and hides AppShell chrome via @media print. Wrote 6 new named browser checks using page.emulateMedia({media:'print'}) + getBoundingClientRect()/getComputedStyle() measurements (mm->px at 96 DPI) plus page.pdf() snapshots, covering all 6 acceptance_matrix criteria. 5 of 6 passed cleanly confirming the fix works as described (A8 16-up, A7 8-up, A6 4-up tiling at true mm sizes with correct 210mm grid width and column counts; AppShell chrome/controls hidden and <main> padding/margin/max-width reset in print media; cutting-guides border toggle correctly transparent-by-default / black-dashed-when-on). One REAL BUG found and confirmed on rerun (not flaky): the global print CSS rule `body > *:not(:has(.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size])) { visibility: hidden }` hides the ENTIRE page content on /tag/{id} (legacy single-tag preview) when print media is emulated, because that route never renders a `.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size]` element -- so the single PriceTag becomes invisible/unreadable in print media, contradicting acceptance criterion 6 which requires it to remain visible and readable. Backend regression suite re-run: same 3 pre-existing out-of-scope failures (appraise live-model fixture image missing, Chiswick seed-flag residue giving 15 shops not 14) -- unrelated to this feature, unchanged from iteration 25.

checks.criterion: Legacy single-tag preview is unaffected on /tag/{id}
checks.name: print-media-legacy-tag-preview-unaffected
checks.evidence: On /tag/{id} with print media emulated: element keeps data-tag-size absent and w-[340px] class as expected, BUT computed visibility is 'hidden' (expected 'visible'). Root cause: index.css print block rule `body > *:not(:has(.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size])) { visibility: hidden; }` (line 390) hides every ancestor branch of the DOM that does not contain a `.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size]` element -- /tag/{id} never renders that element, so the entire page (including the single PriceTag) is hidden in print media. Reproduced identically on rerun (not flaky) -- confirmed via run_browser_script 'print-media-legacy-tag-preview-unaffected' twice, same assertion failure both times, screenshot attached.

bugs.criterion: Legacy single-tag preview is unaffected on /tag/{id}
bugs.description: The print-media CSS added to fix the bulk print-tags grid also breaks printing a single item's tag from /tag/{id}: the selector `body > *:not(:has(.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size])) { visibility: hidden; }` in index.css (~line 390) hides the entire page when no `.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size]` element exists in the DOM. /tag/{id} renders a single unsized PriceTag (no data-tag-size, by design -- it's the legacy fixed-340px preview) so this selector hides it along with everything else, leaving a blank printed page. Fix direction: scope the hide-everything-except-the-grid rule to pages/branches that actually contain `.print-tags-grid[data-tag-size]`, e.g. guard it with a wrapper class only present on PrintTags.tsx, or union the selector with `:has(.print-sheet)` so any printable tag (grid-based or legacy single) stays visible.
bugs.evidence: Browser check print-media-legacy-tag-preview-unaffected: computed visibility 'hidden' on the .print-sheet element, expected 'visible'; reproduced on rerun. Failure screenshot captured. No backend involvement -- this is a pure CSS/frontend defect, cross-checked by the fact that the same markup renders visibility:'visible' when media is 'screen' (pre-emulation assertion `await expect(tag).toBeVisible()` on line above passed).

action_items.detail: Scope the print.css 'hide everything except the print-tags-grid' rule so it doesn't blank out /tag/{id}'s legacy single-tag print preview. See bugs[0] for fix direction.
